reasons.action: The brief only asks for "slow drifting motion" as the animated treatment; it names no figure behavior, performance or locomotion, so the source's observed stance and head turn remain the governing action, licensed by the actual-frame anchor.
reasons.medium: Rendering permission is host-owned and already converts the static sheet to an animated photo with slow drifting motion; the requested medium field is fixed by the schema.
reasons.wardrobe: The request asks for no clothing or accessory change, so the observed black tactical jacket, dark shirt, cargo trousers and combat boots are retained unchanged.
reasons.lighting: Nothing in the brief describes a light, its source, direction or quality; the low-key studio panels and the cool blue-gray night lighting with amber highlights stay reference-governed.
reasons.framing: No shot scale, viewpoint, camera composition or movement is requested — the 16:9 canvas and duration are output parameters, not framing instructions — so the multi-panel sheet layout of the anchored frame is preserved.
reasons.palette: The brief names no grade, hue set, saturation or contrast treatment, so the observed charcoal, cool blue-gray and warm amber tonality remains reference-governed.
